subject: Classification question: Candidate Sofia Martinez (Backend Eng)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Classification question: Candidate Sofia Martinez (Backend Eng)

Neha —

I need HR/compensation help ASAP on Sofia Martinez (backend eng, applied to Backend IC role). Interview loop finished yesterday and the feedback is split: two interviewers put her solidly at L3, one interviewer called out repeated system-design depth and recommended L4. Recruiter pushed an L3 offer band, but hiring interviewers (incl. my buddy on infra) say this is a stretch L4.

Why I'm escalating:
- Candidate has another verbal offer and recruiter says deadline is 2026-05-09 (this is time-sensitive).
- Compensation band difference between L3 mid and low-L4 is ~18% for this role in our region.
- We don't have consensus on leveling documentation in Greenhouse notes; interview comments are qualitative and differ in emphasis.

Attachments: summarized feedback PDF + resume + exported rubric CSV.

Ask: can HR confirm the correct classification workflow here and whether we can make an interim offer (hold subject to comp-council approval) so we don't lose the candidate? Preferably an alignment call today or tomorrow. I can write a 1-paragraph leveling justification if that helps.

Proposed times: 11:00–11:30 PDT today, or 14:00–15:00 PDT tomorrow.

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas Weber
Hiring Manager, Backend Platforms
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Classification question: Candidate Sofia Martinez (Backend Eng)

Thanks for the summary, Jonas.

Quick clarifying questions before we route to comp-council:
1) Which compensation band (level and band) did the recruiter provisionally enter?
2) Can you point to 2–3 interview notes that you consider most indicative of L4 (quote lines are helpful).
3) Is there an internal business justification (project ownership, cross-team impact) that would support a higher baseline?

Process notes: for mid-L4 requests we typically need the leveling justification + 2 interviewer notes called out + hiring manager sign-off. If the candidate has an active deadline, we can do an expedited review but we need the packet no later than 10:00 PDT tomorrow to make an exception and present to compensation council same-day.

We can take a 20-minute alignment call tomorrow at 14:00 PDT — tagging Laura to confirm recruiter availability and to make sure the offer letter template is ready depending on outcome.

If you want to run the quick rationale in an email thread, I can triage and advise whether it's diversion to comp-council or acceptable as a manager-level exception.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
HR Business Partner, Eng
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Classification question: Candidate Sofia Martinez (Backend Eng)

Neha — quick follow. I pasted the two strongest excerpts below (pulled from the PDF):

> Interviewer: "Sofia decomposed the distributed cache invalidation problem into clear failure domains, sketched an eventual-consistency reconciliation protocol, and called out tradeoffs for different shard ownership models. She proposed a practical approach to state migration we use today. I'd hire at L4 for system design ownership."

> Interviewer: "Sofia implemented a production throttling feature at her current company; she talked about latency tradeoffs, retros, and incident post-mortems. She clearly owns cross-service releases."

My read: primary delta is system design + ownership (L4) versus breadth of language/framework experience (L3). Candidate has shipped multiple features end-to-end and would be owning the caching service we need to stabilize this quarter.

Timing: recruiter confirms deadline 2026-05-09 EOD. We risk losing her unless we can present an offer this week. My ask: please escalate to comp-council for an expedited decision, or allow recruiter to send a provisional offer ("subject to final compensation council approval") at low-L4 or high-mid L3 band. I'll take the single-paragraph justification if that helps — see below:

Proposed manager justification (one para): "Candidate demonstrates strong system-design and operational ownership across distributed services, including shipping end-to-end features and owning post-deployment incidents. Role requires immediate ownership of the caching subsystem with cross-team impact; promoting to L4 reflects expected scope and long-term impact. Manager sponsors candidate for early promotion path with measurable milestones."

I'm available on the 14:00 PST call if you want me to walk through specifics.

— Jonas
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Classification question: Candidate Sofia Martinez (Backend Eng)

Thanks for the clear packet and the proposed justification. After speaking with comp-council and reviewing the notes, here's the operational decision:

1) We will classify Sofia as an L3 hire with a formal manager-led early promotion plan to L4 within 9–12 months contingent on the milestones Jonas outlined (ownership of caching subsystem, lead one cross-team rollout, measurable latency improvements).

2) Given the candidate's deadline, Recruiting can issue a provisional offer at high-mid L3 (comp band 3B) with explicit language that there is an agreed performance plan and a review at the 9-month mark. This avoids overspending on an unproven promotion while retaining the candidate.

3) Compensation council approved an expedited exception to finalize the provisional offer this week; Laura will confirm the exact base/RSU mix by EOD tomorrow after final alignment with Talent Ops.

Next steps / owners:
- Jonas: finalize the 1-paragraph leveling justification and share the three bullet milestone metrics for the early promotion plan (by 09:00 PDT tomorrow).
- Laura: finalize provisional offer structure (target comp + equity range) and share draft offer letter template with recruiter.
- Neha: document the agreed promotion path and prepare the formal comp-council submission for the permanent L4 consideration.

I'll keep Monica looped in since this is a critical hire for the infra roadmap. Thanks everyone for moving quickly.

Laura Bennett
Head of Recruiting, Engineering
laura.bennett@redwood.com
